title: 复盘欧莱雅 2025 年补充装推广：消费者兴趣、认知和产品数据
topic: 依据欧莱雅 2025 年公告，将消费者兴趣、认知差距、推广渠道和具体材料减量数据连起来

source.title: L'Oréal invites consumers around the world to join the refill movement
source.section: L’Oréal 全球品牌活动新闻稿
source.type: L’Oréal 全球品牌活动新闻稿
source.context: 补充装推广怎样回应顾客兴趣并减少包装？
paragraphs: Responding to the growing consumer demand for sustainable beauty options, the campaign aims to raise awareness about the benefits of refills. While 78% of consumers express interest in buying more sustainable products, many remain unaware of refillable options and their lower environmental impact.

This campaign showcases the tangible benefits of refills, demonstrating how they can be good for the planet and for the pocket: for example, each time you buy a 100 ml refill instead of rebuying two 50ml bottles of La Vie Est Belle Elixir fragrance you help to save 73% glass, 66% plastic and 61% cardboard.

This campaign showcases L’Oréal’s long-term commitment to reducing its environmental footprint and offering more sustainable solutions to consumers. The Group has also significantly adapted its manufacturing sites around the world to enable a 17-fold increase in the number of refillable options available over the past five years, which now includes some of the world’s best-selling male and female fragrances.
translations: 该活动旨在回应消费者对可持续美容产品日益增长的需求，并提高消费者对补充装益处的认识。虽然 78% 的消费者表示有兴趣购买更多可持续产品，但许多人还不知道补充装的选择及其较低的环境影响。
活动展示了补充装的实际好处：与重新购买两瓶 50 毫升香水相比，购买一瓶 100 毫升补充装可减少 73% 的玻璃、66% 的塑料和 61% 的纸板使用。
过去五年里，欧莱雅调整了全球生产基地，使可补充产品的选择增加到原来的 17 倍。
fullTextParagraphs: L'Oréal Groupe, the world's leading beauty company, will launch its first global multi-brand, multi-category, multi-channel campaign #JoinTheRefillMovement.

Timed to coincide with World Refill Day, on the 16th of June, the campaign is designed to encourage consumers to embrace refills as the latest beauty ritual and contribute to a more sustainable future. It brings together some of the Groupe’s most iconic brands including Lancôme, Armani beauty, Yves Saint Laurent Beauty, Kiehl’s, Mugler, Maison Margiela Fragrances, Prada Beauty, Valentino Beauty, L’Oréal Paris, Kérastase, L’Oréal Professionnel, and La Roche Posay.

In addition to eye-catching advertising and social media content, a dedicated hashtag #JoinTheRefillMovement will serve as a call to action, to encourage consumer participation and engagement. The campaign will be further amplified by major retail partners to raise visibility about the number of refill options now available across a wide range of beauty products.

Responding to the growing consumer demand for sustainable beauty options, the campaign aims to raise awareness about the benefits of refills. While 78% of consumers express interest in buying more sustainable products, many remain unaware of refillable options and their lower environmental impact.

This campaign showcases the tangible benefits of refills, demonstrating how they can be good for the planet and for the pocket: for example, each time you buy a 100 ml refill instead of rebuying two 50ml bottles of La Vie Est Belle Elixir fragrance you help to save 73% glass, 66% plastic and 61% cardboard.

“This campaign brings together some of our most iconic brands to invite consumers everywhere to #JoinTheRefillMovement,” explained Blanca Juti, Chief Corporate Affairs & Engagement Officer at L’Oréal. “We’d love consumers around the world to experience how easy and rewarding it is to make the switch to refills and incorporate them into their regular beauty routines.”

“As the global beauty leader, we have an opportunity, as well as a responsibility to create more circular solutions and set a new industry standard,” explained Ezgi Barcenas, Chief Corporate Responsibility Officer at L’Oréal. “Achieving this vision at scale demands more than innovation – it requires intention and action. That is why we are mobilizing our brands, our business partners, and our consumers to make refills the new norm.”

This campaign showcases L’Oréal’s long-term commitment to reducing its environmental footprint and offering more sustainable solutions to consumers. The Group has also significantly adapted its manufacturing sites around the world to enable a 17-fold increase in the number of refillable options available over the past five years, which now includes some of the world’s best-selling male and female fragrances.
This year’s World Refill Day initiative highlights L’Oréal’s dedication to championing circularity with consumers. The Groupe will continue to innovate and engage consumers to minimize waste.

scenario.title: 练习情境（虚构）：向零售伙伴介绍补充装推广计划
english: A personal-care brand finds that 7 in 10 surveyed customers want less packaging, but many have never noticed the refill shelf.
The team plans to use product pages, shelf signs and short staff demonstrations to make refills easier to find.
The refill pack uses 60% less plastic than two standard bottles. Write three sentences for the retail partner.
chinese: 一家个人护理品牌发现，十分之七的受访顾客希望减少包装，但很多人没注意到补充装货架。
团队计划通过商品页面、货架提示和简短的员工介绍，让顾客更容易找到补充装。
补充装包装比两瓶普通装少用 60% 的塑料。请给零售合作伙伴写三句话。

firstAttempt.prompt: 给零售合作伙伴写三句话：依据欧莱雅 2025 年 6 月 13 日的公告，说明消费者对可持续产品的兴趣与认知落差，介绍活动使用的推广渠道，再用一组明确归属于特定产品的数据说明补充装的实际好处。
firstAttempt.sample: In its June 2025 announcement, L’Oréal said 78% of consumers were interested in buying more sustainable products, while many remained unaware of refill options. The campaign used advertising, social media and retail partners to raise awareness. For La Vie Est Belle Elixir fragrance, a 100 ml refill uses 73% less glass, 66% less plastic and 61% less cardboard than buying two 50 ml bottles.
firstAttempt.rationale: 把兴趣调查和产品材料数据归属于 2025 年公告；保留活动渠道，并限定材料减量数据适用于该具体香水及包装对比。

words.example: Customers can compare refill options on the product page.
words.translation: 顾客可以在商品页面比较补充装选择。

words.example: Show customers the tangible benefits of switching to a refill.
words.translation: 向顾客展示改用补充装的实际好处。

words.example: The shelf signs are designed to raise awareness of refill packs.
words.translation: 这些货架提示旨在提高顾客对补充装的认知。

taskPhrases.example: We need to raise awareness about the refill options available in store.
taskPhrases.translation: 我们需要提高顾客对门店补充装选择的认识。

taskPhrases.collocation: amplify a campaign through retail partners
taskPhrases.example: Retail partners can amplify the campaign through shelf displays.
taskPhrases.translation: 零售合作伙伴可以通过货架陈列扩大活动传播。

taskPhrases.example: The refill pack uses less glass and plastic than two standard bottles.
taskPhrases.translation: 与两瓶普通装相比，补充装使用的玻璃和塑料更少。

structure.original: While 78% of consumers express interest in buying more sustainable products, many remain unaware of refillable options and their lower environmental impact.
analysis: While 在这里引出对照：消费者有兴趣，但许多人不了解现有补充装。
主句 many remain unaware of 保留了认知缺口；表达调查结论时不要把“有兴趣”说成“已经购买”。
structure.transfer: While customers ask for lower-waste packaging, many still do not know where to find refills.

rewrite.bad: People like sustainable products, so our campaign will be successful.
rewrite.good: In its June 2025 announcement, L’Oréal said 78% of consumers were interested in buying more sustainable products, while many remained unaware of refill options. The campaign used advertising, social media and retail partners to raise awareness. For La Vie Est Belle Elixir fragrance, a 100 ml refill uses 73% less glass, 66% less plastic and 61% less cardboard than buying two 50 ml bottles.
rewrite.translation: 欧莱雅在 2025 年 6 月的公告中表示，78% 的消费者有兴趣购买更多可持续产品，但许多人仍不了解补充装选择。该活动通过广告、社交媒体和零售合作伙伴提高认知。对于 La Vie Est Belle Elixir 香水，与购买两瓶 50 毫升装相比，一瓶 100 毫升补充装少用 73% 的玻璃、66% 的塑料和 61% 的纸板。
rewrite.pattern: [date and state consumer insight] → [name campaign channels] → [attribute a product-specific benefit]

dictation.label: 听写关键句 1
dictation.text: Many consumers are interested in more sustainable products but are unaware of refill options.
dictation.why: 注意 but 连接兴趣与认知之间的转折。

apply.prompt: 许多顾客对补充装感兴趣，但还不知道在哪里可以买到。

dictation.label: 原文要点听写（自然改写）
dictation.text: A 100 ml refill uses 73% less glass than buying two bottles that each hold 50 ml.
dictation.why: 注意 two bottles that each hold 50 ml，明确是两瓶、每瓶 50 毫升，避免把 two 50 ml 听成 250 ml。

choice.prompt: 调查显示顾客对补充装有兴趣，但不少人不知道商品在哪里。哪句同时保留了这个落差和下一步？
options: Customers have already switched to refills, so we can stop explaining the options.
Many customers are interested in refills but are unaware of them; we should make the options easier to find.
Customers are not interested in sustainable products.
choice.why: 第二句保留了“有兴趣但不了解”的调查信息，并提出可执行的改进方向。

output.prompt: 练习迁移（虚构咖啡品牌）：一项调查发现，65% 的顾客愿意尝试可重复使用的咖啡杯，但门店里的参与方式不明显。公司准备在收银台放提示卡，并让员工在顾客点单时简单介绍。请给门店运营负责人写三句话：说明发现、安排和希望改善的结果。
output.sample: Our survey found that 65% of customers are open to using a reusable coffee cup, but the program is not easy to spot in store. We can raise awareness with clear checkout signs and a short explanation from baristas. That should make the program easier to understand and join.
check: 引用调查结果并指出认知缺口
说明提示卡和员工介绍的安排
说明安排如何帮助顾客参与
